## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup
- [ ] Docs

## Checklist

- [ ] `make ci` passes (lint + test + build)
- [ ] Added/updated tests where the change has a strong contract (auth, parsers, cluster, response shape)
- [ ] i18n keys added to both `en.json` and `ko.json` (if UI strings changed)
- [ ] No secrets, real IPs/hostnames, or personal data in the diff
